robinson-collected-poems.case: Bloom lists Robinson's Selected Poems (generic). The Macmillan Collected Poems (1921) gathers every volume from The Children of the Night to Lancelot -- the core of his work.
robinson-collected-poems.note: Later long poems (Tristram 1927 etc.) are in the 1929 enlarged Collected Poems; IA has 1929 copies (e.g. collectedpoems0000edwi_w6s0, unread). PG also has the separate volumes (313, 1035, 1040, 40906, 76699, 77544).
